notes.title: Halloween Special
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43078705/c2d1950459986f21cbb53305375d0318e1e14683.png[/img]

Yes that's right... Moving Shadows has received a Halloween update - and Moving Shadows is now spoopier than ever!

Moving Shadows is a fun, fast-paced, horror game with a twisted hand-painted art style. Get thrown into a creepy maze and collect all the flowers before the monsters get you!

Moving Shadows aims to bring you a self-aware horror game that is actually FUN to play, offering lots of scares that will make you jump - and laugh!

[b]Moving Shadows Halloween Special[/b] is our first ever EVENT. This event will be closing at the end of November! Your progress will be recorded on the [b]Events[/b] tab in the Extras Menu after the next update.

In these levels, there will be no torch or batteries. Instead, follow the trail of [b]sweeties[/b] which will lead you to a [b]lantern[/b] - this will be your light source. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43078705/632d99b8a1228e86aea87586c509b9cf267f932c.png[/img]

We also have a new arrival coming. You may see them once at the beginning, but usually they're completely [b]invisible[/b]; their location is only identifiable from the trail of planted [b]pumpkins[/b].

If you run into them, you will have to quickly [b]plant[/b] pumpkins around them to survive.

Good luck and have a Happy Halloween!

~ Ethan
   [i]Developer of Moving Shadows[/i]
